Waveshare demo behavior attribution

The CHIPO 0.6.8 DrawPanel interaction model and spirit-level calibration criteria are adapted from the public Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75 examples:
- firmware/brookesia/components/draw/Drawpanel.cpp
- firmware/brookesia/components/Gravitysphere/Gravitysphere.cpp

Copyright 2023-2026 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD.
Source repository: https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75
License: Apache License, Version 2.0. A copy is included in this directory.

CHIPO adapts the interaction/calibration behavior to its own LVGL component, black AMOLED presentation, and existing QMI8658 data path. The Brookesia application framework and its separate IMU driver are not included.
